{"story":{"what":"Adds a public GeneratedMessagePackFormatterAttribute, with an optional SurrogateType, to MessagePack.Annotations. The source generator now finds partial classes that carry this attribute and implement IMessagePackFormatter<T>. It builds a serialization model for T with the new GeneratedFormatterCollector and writes the formatter body into the user's partial class. By default T is serialized in contractless mode: its public read-write members go under string keys. A surrogate type's [Key] and [IgnoreMember] attributes can define the keys and which members are included instead. Four new diagnostics (MsgPack019 to MsgPack022) report misuse, and there are tests, a test library with no MessagePack reference, and docs.","why":"MP-2129 asks for a source-generated formatter for a type declared in a referenced library that has no MessagePack attributes or dependency.
